state.listing: Bright two-room flat on the 4th floor, facing a quiet inner courtyard. Big south windows in both rooms. Kitchen redone in 2023, bathroom original but clean. Tram stop 2 minutes away. Small pets welcome.

quiet.instructions: How quiet does the listing say the flat is?
criteria: Says it is noisy: busy street, bars, works nearby
Some hint of calm: a side street or upper floor
Says it is quiet: courtyard side, quiet street, no traffic

light.instructions: How much daylight does the listing say the flat gets?
criteria: Says it is dark: ground floor facing a wall, small windows
Some daylight: windows mentioned, no direction or size
Very bright: big windows, south or west facing, top floor

condition.instructions: What state is the flat in, from the listing?
criteria: Needs work: damage, old fittings, renovation needed
Mixed: some parts new, some old but kept up

pets_allowed.instructions: Does the listing say pets are allowed?
